Test data cleaned up via API afterwards.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionPlansPanel.jsx is now 1176 lines — still recommended to split into DoorEditor, HardwareCatalogCard, PlansList sub-components for maintainability.

Hardware-line row inputs (qty, part_number) lack data-testid attributes. Only pp-hw-desc-{idx} and pp-hw-price-{idx} are addressable. Consider adding pp-hw-qty-{idx} and pp-hw-pn-{idx} for finer-grained tests (this iteration used DOM traversal to work around it).
review_request lists testid 'pp-hw-new-add' but the actual DOM uses 'pp-hw-add' — align naming or update spec.
The datalist #pp-hw-catalog is shared but pp-hw-desc-${idx} uses only the door index, so multiple hardware rows on the same door share the same testid — consider pp-hw-desc-${dk}-${hk}.
